content:
Chapter 273 Winning Is Fine

"who!"

Xu Zijing was shocked.

Someone could suddenly appear behind him without knowing it.

But I didn't feel anything at all.

But when he saw the person behind him, for some reason, he suddenly became discouraged.

"It turns out to be Miss Lu, I'm so respectful."

Seeing that it was Lu Xue, Xu Zijing bowed slightly and expressed his respect.

This gift is not because of Lu Xue's strength, but because of Lu Xue's financial resources.

Lu Xue looked around, looked suspiciously at the sword-holding boy who was closed on the competition stand, and then asked, "What did you just say?"

Behind Lu Xue, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo also looked at Xu Zijing and others.

After the three of them arrived at the square, they saw that the atmosphere in the square was a bit heavy, and only Xu Zijing was whispering.

Then a few people came over.

"Uh, Miss Lu, we're talking about that nine-clawed dragon."

"Is this one?"

Lu Xue asked, pointing at Ao Qing who was crawling on his arm.

Seeing Ao Qing, Xu Zijing smiled and said, "Yes, that's it."

......

The air was quiet for a long time.

Xu Zijing and others immediately widened their eyes and looked at Ao Qing on Lu Xue's arm.

"What are you looking at? I've never seen such a handsome dragon!"

Ao Qing scolded angrily, and the few of them came to their senses.

At this time, they remembered that there seemed to be a dragon beside Lu Xue, but they remember it wasn't Jiuzhao.

"Miss Lu, it turns out that the nine-clawed dragon is yours."

After Xu Zijing reacted, he immediately said haha.

However, the students from the academy beside him looked at Ao Qing with shiny eyes.

"Miss Lu, for the honor of the academy, please let this young master Long fight for the academy!"

Several people said repeatedly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue and his friends immediately looked at the competition stand.

With a little heard along the way, the few people immediately understood what was going on.

Someone challenged the academy.

And now it seems that he lost a lot.

At the same time, the knife-holding boy on the competition stage suddenly opened his eyes and then looked at Lu Xue and the others.

For a moment, the eyes met.

"Good boy, you dare to look at me. Master, hurry up, let me go up and teach him a lesson!"

When Ao Qing saw the sword-holding boy on the competition stage looking at this place, he was furious.

Hearing this, Lu Xue didn't say anything.

"Well, Brother Qing calms down, this kid, just let me do it."

At this time, Xiao Luo, who had been silent, interrupted.

"You, you are not as strong as me yet, so let me do it."

Qin Feng also spoke.

Obviously, I am very confident in my strength.

Both of them have achieved huge improvements in the secret realm, so they are eager to see their strength.

Watching the two fight over it.

Ao Qing snorted lightly and said nothing.

I don't care so much about that kind of clown.

Whoever plays differently.

The same thing is said, he is invincible under the Immortal Emperor Realm.

In the end, Qin Feng stood on the competition platform.

"Damn, Qin Feng?!"

"Isn't this kid the last few in the martial arts list? How dare he stand on the competition platform?"

"No, no, no, this kid is still a little powerful, he is the 52nd place in the martial arts list ten years ago."

Now he is in the bottom of the martial arts list, just because Qin Feng has not made the ranking for ten years and has been squeezed out.

In ten years, who knows what strength Qin Feng has improved to?

But everyone didn't believe that Qin Feng could win.

laugh!

At this time, Qin Feng suddenly pulled out the long sword behind him, and the sound of the sword suddenly buzzed.

A long robe is automatically without wind.

This is Qin Feng’s unique pre-war style.

In terms of strength, Qin Feng is not outstanding in the academy, and is even a little transparent.

But in terms of aura and style, Qin Feng is definitely the second best.

"Who are you? Sign up?"

Seeing Qin Feng standing in front of him with a sword, his eyes closed slightly, as if he was invincible in the world, but he didn't say a word, the young man holding the sword frowned slightly.

At this moment, he was very suspicious, was this really a student of Tiandi Academy?

When Qin Feng heard this, he looked at the sword-holding boy in the distance and slowly said, "You are not worthy of knowing my name."

"How dare you insult my academy!"

laugh!

The sound of the sword sounded again, and a powerful sword intent surged out of Qin Feng's body.

The space around her body began to buzz under this sword intent.

Seeing this, everyone below twitched slightly.

This is another set.

Basically, every time Qin Feng fights against others, he will pretend to be a big b-like. Generally, those who are not familiar with Qin Feng will be frightened by Qin Feng's trick.

But in the end, I found that Qin Feng looked very strong, but in fact his strength was much weaker than he showed.

Gorgeous but not solid.

But they didn't know that this was Qin Feng's sword.

At this moment, the boy holding the knife looked solemn.

The opponent's strength is very strong.

Finally, I met an opponent.

The boy holding a knife changed to holding a knife with one hand, but instead holding a knife with both hands, and his sword intent was also venting his crazily.

"You are very good."

"I hope you can satisfy me."

When Qin Feng heard this, he sneered, "Haha, the frog in the well, I don't know the vastness of the world, so let you see what is the true unparalleled swordsmanship!"

As soon as the words fell.

Countless swords formed by the intent of swords emerged from all around.

For a moment, the sword of the Idiom filled the entire competition platform, which was extremely shocking.

Buzz —

At the same time, a strange phenomenon emerged, and a long river covered with swordsmanship suddenly surged out from Qin Feng, crossing the entire competition platform.

Qin Feng held it out with one hand, and the entire long river was immediately held in Qin Feng.

In the distance, when the young man with a knife saw this scene, he was stunned.

This person's strength in the Immortal Saint Realm can actually use the long river of swords. How is that possible?

What's even more terrifying is that at most others only guide the power in the long river to fight against the enemy, but this kid directly held the entire long river of swordsmanship with one hand.

What a century of joke!

For a moment, the knife in the boy holding the knife could no longer hold the knife.

This time I really encountered a tough character.

"Boy, I wonder if I can take this attack?"

Qin Feng's extremely cold voice sounded, and the boy holding his own sword kept echoing in his ears.

Hearing this, the young man holding the knife couldn't help but tremble.

Can it be taken?

If he really felt such strength, it would be a bit uneasy.

The boy holding the knife wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, pondered for a moment, and gritted his teeth and said, "Come on, I'm in the same realm, can you still be afraid of you!"

In order to increase his courage, the young man holding the knife endured the pressure and rushed straight towards Qin Feng in the distance.

At this time, Qin Feng's sword came out.

Create a world! The scene of , , did not appear, but a slight sword light was cut off from the competition platform.

A faint ripples appeared.

The boy holding the knife naturally saw this scene, but at this moment his expression changed, and it was too late to stop.

"Sister Xue, this, Brother Qin is really strong."

Xiao Luo looked at Qin Feng's fighting style and looked a little embarrassed.

Not to mention anything else, this whole work is really incomparable.

Lu Xue was also a little embarrassed, but then said, "It's enough to win."
